title: Graph Domain Adaptation Does Not End with Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.25692v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph domain adaptation (GDA) transfers knowledge from a labeled source graph to an unlabeled target graph under shifts in both node attributes and graph structure. Existing methods primarily adapt graph representations through propagation redesign, distribution alignment, or source-to-target transition modeling, but still rely on a single graph-propagating path for target prediction. This leaves open whether an adapted graph representation exhausts the predictive evidence available in the target domain, since the graph-aware expert and graph-free local expert may exhibit different failure modes under topological shifts. To address this limitation, we propose EviGDA, an Evidence-Augmented Graph Domain Adaptation framework that complements graph representation adaptation with a graph-free local expert. translated_title: 图域自适应并不止于表示学习
translated_abstract: 图域自适应（GDA）旨在节点属性和图结构同时发生偏移的情况下，将知识从有标签的源图迁移到无标签的目标图。现有方法主要通过传播机制重设计、分布对齐或源到目标转移建模来适配图表示，但在目标预测时仍依赖于单一的图传播路径。这就留下了一个悬而未决的问题：适配后的图表示是否已穷尽目标域中可用的预测证据，因为图感知专家与无图局部专家在拓扑偏移下可能表现出不同的失效模式。为解决这一局限，我们提出了EviGDA，一个证据增强的图域自适应框架，它通过引入无图局部专家来补充图表示适配。其中，图感知专家执行消息传递和熵感知的边缘分布对齐，而无图局部专家仅从（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出证据增强的图域自适应框架EviGDA，通过引入无图局部专家与图感知专家互补，弥补了单一图传播路径在拓扑偏移下预测证据不足的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes EviGDA, an evidence-augmented graph domain adaptation framework that complements graph representation adaptation with a graph-free local expert, addressing the insufficient predictive evidence of relying solely on a single graph-propagating path under topological shifts.
